run_calculate_runner: run a CalculateRunner to execute calculations using an ASE calculator and save results to file
implement_calculate_method: implement the abstract calculate method in a CalculateRunner subclass to perform ASE calculations
implement_write_results_method: implement the abstract write_results method in a CalculateRunner subclass to save calculation output
load_state_from_checkpoint: load a CalculateRunner state from a checkpoint directory to resume interrupted calculations
create_calculate_runner_subclass: create a subclass of CalculateRunner that implements calculate and write_results for custom predictions
